Affiliate Members
As a private membership organization, AICE, the Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc. offers complimentary Affiliate Membership for individuals, not institutions.  Individuals seeking Affiliate Membership must be employed by state-approved schools, by accredited degree-granting institutions of higher education, by ministries of education / similar national recognition bodies, or by qualifying professional boards recognized by AICE.  An important benefit of becoming an AICE Affiliate is participation in shaping credential evaluation standards discussed during month Credential Forums:  AICE standards represent an ongoing and collaborative effort to promote consistency and proper due diligence in the credentials evaluation field.
Qualifying applicants for Affiliate Membership must evaluate educational documents for internal institutional usage only; that is, their institutions must not provide revenue-generating, credential-evaluation services for the public at large.  All Affiliate Member applications are subject to review and approval to ensure that eligibility criteria are met.  AICE reserves the right to deny an application without explanation.

Additional benefits of becoming an AICE Affiliate include:
Participation in monthly AICE Credential Forum discussions;
Inclusion on the AICE Affiliate list;
Access to members-only resources on the AICE website;
Networking opportunities with AICE Endorsed and Affiliate Members;
Service on AICE committees;
Participation in joint research and publication efforts;
Access to the services of AICE consultants.
[Note: AICE Affiliates do not have voting privileges.]
